visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Flex column instead of block with margins
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Each item is separated by a bottom margin written on every element. Use a flex column with gap for the spacing. The items must keep their order.

solution.code:
First

Second

Third
solution.explanation: gap puts space between items only, not after the last one, and it is written once on the container. Margins on each child need to be repeated and removed for the last item.

checks.label: The items read First, Second, Third
The items are stacked
checks.expr: (() => { var p = document.querySelectorAll('.list p'); return p[0].offsetTop < p[1].offsetTop && p[1].offsetTop < p[2].offsetTop; })()

checks.label: The gap between items is 10px
checks.expr: (() => { var p = document.querySelectorAll('.list p'); return p[1].offsetTop - (p[0].offsetTop + p[0].offsetHeight) === 10; })()
